items.title: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Stock Looks Fully Valued Despite Firewall Patch News
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks has delivered strong multi year gains for shareholders, and the recent share price around US$356 raises a simple question for anyone looking at the stock today: Are the cash flows that the business is expected to generate enough to support that kind of valuation? Over the past 5 years the share price has returned about 310.3%, which puts a lot of weight on whether the underlying cash generation can keep backing up that performance. items.title: Cloudflare’s CEO Says Its Post-Quantum Encryption May Really Be “Post-AI Cryptography”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCloudflare CEO Matthew Prince said the company’s move to post-quantum cryptography may turn out to be “post-AI cryptography,” after an unverified rumor that AI labs’ math work could crack RSA encryption. Cloudflare has promised never to charge for that encryption, so it pays off through the paid products customers buy once their traffic runs on its network.

items.title: Exploits Arrive in “10 to 15 Minutes,” Patches in 45 Days, per Cisco’s Jeetu Patel. Cue CrowdStrike
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCisco’s Jeetu Patel says attackers can exploit a newly announced software flaw within 10 to 15 minutes, while patching takes about 45 days. Patching faster brings its own risk, as recent outages at JPMorgan Chase and Microsoft show.

items.title: Why Is Palo Alto Networks Stock Sliding Today?
items.summary: Shares of Palo Alto Networks (NASDAQ:PANW) fell 1. 8% in pre-market trading on Friday after a former executive filed a federal lawsuit alleging that he was dismissed for challenging accounting practices that he claims were intended to inflate the cybersecurity company’s revenue.
